description: This file defines API endpoints for configuration management, feature toggles, runtime configuration retrieval, and related utility functions within a FastAPI application. It includes routes for CRUD operations on configurations and feature toggles, as well as endpoints for runtime config and feature checks, with access control based on user roles.

classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to register API endpoints.
